visualReview.method: nearest-neighbour inspection of frozen target and isolated layer against the original c02 crop and the raw full-dressed source
visualReview.helmet: PASS: the helmet has continuous rounded left/right blue-and-gold cups and a curved dome; no rectangular panel, crop artifact, or hard cutoff is visible.
visualReview.faceAndEars: PASS: the visor retains both eyes clearly, natural ear tips are fully hidden, and no pink-ear remnant appears at either side.
visualReview.collar: PASS: the collar ends above the chest with a smooth curved rim; no halo, square band, or vertical seam is visible.
visualReview.anatomy: PASS: the screen-right tail and the raised front paw remain visibly original and unobscured; the helmet layer does not read as consuming body fur, chest, legs, or paw.
visualReview.overall: PASS: at release-review zoom this reads as a fully redrawn, integrated worn helmet for the raised-paw pose, not a pasted accessory.

scopeLimit: Approval is limited to c02/revision-1 source, same-coordinate layer and mask. It does not approve the other head-20 cells, runtime manifest registration, or a push.
